title: Explore World verification and mobile refinements
summary: Verified the first Explore World implementation: 177 map entries, 29 topics, eight-planet comparison, nine missions, journal persistence and reviewed-context Tutor navigation.

changes.detail: Adds sourced turtle, whale, pollinator, bird and desert lessons, original nature illustrations, and repeatable local browser checks.
Localizes category navigation, makes it horizontally scrollable, and documents reproducible checks and content coverage.

Corrects cramped mobile globe controls, maintains 2:1 proportions on the 2D map, prevents empty country actions and removes planet-shaped illustrations from non-planet topics. Fixes a lint purity finding by initializing daily discovery once per screen mount.

validation.name: TypeScript and focused ESLint
validation.detail: App tsc --noEmit and ESLint on new module, world route, explorer and Tutor passed.

validation.name: Automated model, history and API regression tests
validation.detail: 22 tests passed: catalog validity, question evidence, serialized backup round-trip, mission gates, malformed data, adaptive ordering, polygon selection, reviewed Tutor context, append-only history, authenticated backup ownership/conflict handling and Tutor API contracts.

validation.name: Offline globe browser checks
validation.detail: Installed Edge verified 3D country selection, zoom, 2D point selection, mobile dimensions, labels/borders/reset and forced WebGL fallback. Screenshots inspected.

validation.name: Exported app interaction checks
validation.detail: Local browser with isolated mock auth verified map-to-country navigation, bookmarks, wrong/correct feedback, Morocco mission completion, planet comparison, mobile overflow, persistence after reload and Tutor route handoff. Screenshots inspected.

validation.name: Expo web and Android export
validation.detail: Web and Android bundles exported successfully. Android export is a bundling check, not a physical-device performance result.

validation.name: Live services and device coverage
validation.detail: No live database write/restore, paid AI response, physical Android gesture/performance, or production deployment was performed. Cloud backup is manual using the existing authenticated API.

validation.name: Content coverage and language limits
validation.detail: Expanded country profiles cover Morocco and Brazil; 175 other map entries are basic sourced records. Lessons are introductory English content with multilingual Tutor access, not a fully translated encyclopedia. Visuals are stylized; there is no orbital simulator or live satellite data.
